483-789-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
483-789-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant, Gutter Grime and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Gutter Grime ability, creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

206-2023-3755-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

7299-8202.description:
Activate The Echoverse Fulcrum by paying {5}, tapping and exiling it, destroying all creatures.
Cast Biorhythm by paying its mana cost, causing each player's life total to become equal to the number of creatures they control.
Each player that controls no creatures loses the game due to having 0 life.
7299-8202.notes: You will also lose the game if you control no creatures as Biorhythm resolves, causing the game to end in a draw. You can avoid this by putting a creature onto the battlefield after step 1, or by having an indestructible creature. Similarly, any opponent who controls an indestructible creature will not have 0 life or lose the game.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3132-3259-6965.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
3132-3259-6965.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3132-3259-6965.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Bladewing, triggering Breath of Fury and Bladewing.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1987-2020-7487.easyPrerequisites:
You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
Vadrik has at least 2 power.
1987-2020-7487.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Zealous Lorecaster.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2020-7487.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

215-1849-3043.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with defender.
215-1849-3043.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Axebane Guardian from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Axebane Guardian by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4460-6006-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4460-6006-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4460-6006-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2811-4186-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2811-4186-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1020-2866-6518-7646.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7322.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Big Mother Mouser.
When Big Mother Mouser dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control except Donatello

1753-3259-7291.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control an artifact creature.
1753-3259-7291.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Donatello and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Donatello and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Donatello trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact creature.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the artifact creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase

4013-4659-5004-6643-7183.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {C}{C}.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Edgar.
Cast Cathodion from your graveyard by paying {2}.
Repeat.

5170-6132-6634-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

5170-5256-5933-6132.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2061-2103-6991.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Capture of Jingzhou each turn.
2061-2103-6991.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Donnie & April.
Put the Donnie & April token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Donnie & April token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

141-2921-6817.description:
Cast Presumed Dead by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Presumed Dead, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Presumed Dead.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from step 5.

2173-2448-3845-5220.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2173-2448-3845-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

339-677-1849-2511.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1399-1606-1680-2404.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures.
1399-1606-1680-2404.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

500-1181-2493.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Archaeomancer and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Archaeomancer tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Sacrifice from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing a Archaeomancer token, adding an amount of {B} equal to its mana value. 
Repeat.

2034-2558-3490-5330-6701.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-2558-3490-5330-6701.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel. If desired, you can sacrifice the Servos as well.

4826-5411-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
4826-5411-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.

440-1339-2428-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-2428-5231.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God and Horizon Chimera trigger.
Resolve the Locust God trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Horizon Chimera trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

238-1365-1477-3967.notablePrerequisites: Gerrard has no more than one -1/-1 counter on it.
238-1365-1477-3967.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Gerrard persist until end of turn.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Cauldron of Souls, putting a +1/+1 counter on Gerrard.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Gerrard.
When Gerrard dies, it and its persist ability trigger.
Resolve the Gerrard persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the second Gerrard trigger, failing to exile it as it has left your graveyard, and returning Cauldron of Souls from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 3.
Repeat.

232-2557-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Priest of Urabrask that are 6/6 Dinosaurs.
When the Priest of Urabrask tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding six {R}.
Repeat.

215-2404-2872-3464.notablePrerequisites:
Clever Conjurer does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three other creatures.
215-2404-2872-3464.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout to your hand.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters, it triggers itself, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Clever Conjurer any number of times.

2358-2498-4691.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2358-2498-4691.description:
Activate Blood Celebrant by paying {B} and 1 life.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Sheoldred's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Blood Celebrant ability, adding {B}.
Repeat as desired.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3175-3455-4349.notablePrerequisites:
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
You have the highest life total.
670-1619-3175-3455-4349.description:
Cast Sun Titan by paying {4}{W}{W}.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it, Radiant Solar and Vizier of Many Faces trigger.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Fell Stinger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fell Stinger enters the battlefield, its exploit ability, Radiant Solar and Vizier of Many Faces trigger.
Resolve the Fell Stinger trigger, causing you to sacrifice it.
Fell Stinger's second ability triggers, causing target player to draw 2 cards and lose 2 life.
Resolve the Vizier of Many Faces trigger from step 4, causing you to venture into the "Trapped Entry" room of Tomb of Annihilation, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 4, causing you to venture into the "Veils of Fear" room, causing each player to discard a card or lose 2 life.
Resolve the Vizier of Many Faces trigger from step 2, causing you to venture into the "Sandfall Cell" room, causing you to sacrifice Sun Titan and each opponent to either sacrifice a creature, artifact or land, or lose 2 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 2, causing you to venture into the "Cradle of the Death God" room, creating a legendary 4/4 The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

777-3532-3594-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Toothy triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

371-876-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Forests.
371-876-5003.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Llanowar Druid.
Activate five Forests by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Llanowar Druid by tapping and sacrificing it.
Llanowar Druid dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Llanowar Druid from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Llanowar Druid ability from step 3, untapping all Forests.
Repeat.

1595-1849-3259.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another artifact creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1595-1849-3259.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Sharding Sphinx.
Resolve the Sharding Sphinx trigger, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Thopter token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

4050-4365-4573.description:
Activate Sacred Mesa by paying {1}{W}, creating two 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Pegasus, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

859-2952.notablePrerequisites:
Sorcerer's Wand attached to Lurking Roper.
You have a way to give Lurking Roper lifelink.
Lurking Roper does not have summoning sickness.
859-2952.description:
Give Lurking Roper lifelink, if needed.
Activate Lurking Roper by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Lurking Roper triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.

38-2316-3129.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Goblins.
38-2316-3129.description:
Activate Goblin Warrens by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing two Goblins, creating six 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Skirk Prospector three times by sacrificing three Goblins, adding {2}{R}.
Repeat.

225-3230-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
225-3230-4222.description:
Activate Coral Atoll by tapping it, adding {C}{U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Coral Atoll.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Repeat any number of times.
